findings.text: record_landed_exemptions is now dead production code: its only caller is tests/test_the_lander_leaves_a_red_run_to_its_coordinator.py:698, and it is named after the exact behaviour this change removed (closing unreviewed findings as exempted). A future caller reaching for it would close a finding the landing rule now leaves open; it should be retired together with the test that still exercises it.

record_landed_deferrals resolves the stored record once at :666 to choose the indexes and then calls _write_disposition_against_finding per index, which resolves the record again and commits once per finding, so a landing with N deferred findings now performs N+1 store reads and N commits where the previous implementation wrote the record once. Behaviour is correct; the repeated resolution and commit is avoidable churn on the record's history.
